verdict: Organic local presence is growing; paid ads remain fully paused.
narrative: Paid advertising has been fully off for the entire 28-day window, so there are no leads or ad spend to report from those channels. Your Google Business Profile picked up the slack — 53 total actions this period, and that number grew 8.33% week over week without any paid support behind it. Website sessions also rose 18% in the most recent 7-day stretch, a directional sign that organic interest is building. We're monitoring whether that inbound traffic is being captured through your intake process, and that connection is being reviewed now.
